exposure: attitude towards caesarean section on maternal request
outcome: obstetrical care providers' perceptions about low-risk women
opinion about a woman's right to choose her delivery method
willingness to perform caesarean section on maternal request
cohort: The study included 109 obstetrical care providers from five hospitals with at least 4000 births per year.
finding: The study revealed a strong association between perceptions and personal beliefs of practitioners and mode of delivery, with a high level of support for caesarean section on maternal request despite high existing rates in Pakistan.
mod_finding: Providers' age, number of biological children, own mode of delivery, training status, and years of experience were associated with willingness to perform caesarean section on maternal request, although these associations were not statistically significant.
